name: postman-api-collections
description: Curated Postman collections with pre/post-request scripts, Newman CI integration, and HTML Extra reports

scripts.test:all: npm run test:validate && npm run test:secops && npm run test:demo-portal && npm run test:support-agent
scripts.report:secops: newman run collections/security-api-audit/secops-api-audit.postman_collection.json -e environments/secops-sandbox.postman_environment.example.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman-reports/secops-api-audit-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "SecOps API Audit Report"
scripts.report:demo-portal: newman run collections/api-doc-demo-portal/api-doc-demo-portal.postman_collection.json -e environments/api-doc-demo-portal-sandbox.postman_environment.example.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman-reports/api-doc-demo-portal-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "API Demo Portal Report"
scripts.report:support-agent: newman run collections/tech-support-agent/ai-tech-support-agent.postman_collection.json -e environments/tech-support-agent.postman_environment.example.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman-reports/tech-support-agent-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Tech Support Agent Report"
scripts.report:all: npm run report:secops && npm run report:demo-portal && npm run report:support-agent

author: donny-devops
